Clamp probabilities away from 0 and 1

Source: R/fn_calibration.R
clamp.Rd

Bound probabilities into [eps, 1 - eps] so that logit transforms stay finite. Used by the calibration helpers before qlogis.

Usage

clamp(p, eps = 1e-06)

Arguments

p

Numeric vector of probabilities.

eps

Small margin; values are clamped to [eps, 1 - eps].

Value

Numeric vector the same length as p.
